newsitem.title: USA: U.S. cash soymeal - Offers mostly flat, Illinois up.
newsitem.headline: U.S. cash soymeal - Offers mostly flat, Illinois up.

text.p: U.S. rail and truck soymeal basis offers were mostly steady on Tuesday but some Illinois locations noted firmer values as a major processor took down time, several cash brokers said.

"Decatur is down for a few days and it looks like they'll probably be down through Friday," a Kentucky broker said. "The demand is still there so (other nearby processors) are pushing their prices up a bit."
Archer Daniels Midland officials did not return calls regarding talk of its Decatur, Il. plant closing.
Movement was slow as end-users continued to buy hand to mouth. Several dealers said they expected conditions to remain slow until the CBOT September contract expires.
That contract was trading at a $10.00 per ton premium to the October.
"We've got such a spread between the Sept and the Oct," one broker said. "They're just waiting for the Sept to be gone so they can take advantage of a product that's $10.00 cheaper."
